key_insight: MonteRET combines whole-CT understanding, region-level retrieval, and knowledge-guided rewriting to generate more complete chest CT findings sections.
clinical_relevance: If validated in practice, this approach could help radiology teams produce more consistent reports with fewer missed findings, especially in complex chest CTs.
method: Trained on 24,128 chest CT scans from RadGenome-ChestCT.
Uses global CT features plus region-level anatomical representations and predicted medical conditions to retrieve relevant knowledge.
Refines draft reports with a knowledge-guided rewriting agent.
evidence_signal: The model was evaluated on 1,564 internal test CT scans and 82 external CT scans, and was favored by radiology residents while improving recall and overall report quality versus baselines.
watch_item: Performance gains came from retrospective testing, so real-world workflow impact, error modes, and safety under diverse clinical settings still need prospective validation.
paper_title: MonteRET: AI Agent Enhancing Multimodal LLMs with Multi-granularity Knowledge Retrieval for Chest CT Report Generation
